note: BETA. A synthetic-identity bust-out (stage 1) ages a set of accounts, which then run a low-observability authorised-push-style cash-out (stage 2) to ordinary payees. Recall on the stage-2 fraud is reported for the supervised classifier alone vs the full two-channel ensemble, at a matched ~1% legit alert budget.
finding: the chain evades the supervised classifier (recall collapses); the novelty channel still catches it, and retraining restores the supervised channel - the two-channel design and the loop both earn their keep against a combined threat.
